faq.q: How much does Ciccarelli Law Offices charge?
faq.a: Ciccarelli Law Offices publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Ciccarelli Law Offices offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Ciccarelli Law Offices publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Ciccarelli Law Offices have offices?
faq.a: Ciccarelli Law Offices publishes seven offices, among them West Chester, Lancaster, Philadelphia and Downingtown. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Ciccarelli Law Offices?
faq.a: Ciccarelli Law Offices names nine attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
